summary: Full E2E test of Workout Delete feature. Backend (6/6 pytest passing) covered POST /activity/log returning steps+id, GET /activity/daily workout shape {id,title,steps,caloriesBurned,activeMinutes,distanceKm,loggedAt}, DELETE /activity/workout/:id decrementing aggregates and 404 on invalid/already-deleted id with message 'Workout not found'. Frontend E2E (mobile 390x844) walked Activity screen: baseline (steps=9,890 cal=445 dist=7.6 time=49) -> FAB > Add Workout > preset-0 > submit -> workout item + trash icon appeared, values increased -> clicked delete -> 'Workout removed' toast appeared, empty state reappeared, all four aggregates returned to exact baseline via TanStack cache invalidation (no manual reload). Regression spot-check on Dashboard/Explore/Nutrition/Profile pages rendered fine.
critical_code_review_comments: ActivityRepository.removeWorkoutEntry does a findOne then a second findOneAndUpdate ($inc + $pull). Not atomic under concurrent deletes of the same workout; a race could double-decrement. Consider a single $pull with an aggregation update, or use a transaction. Low priority since single-user demo app.

deleteWorkout controller returns 200 with getDaily payload; if a client deletes but there are no other workouts, the returned object is still full daily view (correct). No pagination/consistency issues observed.
test_credentials: None - single seeded user Grace, no auth
seed_data_creation: DB was re-seeded via `npx ts-node src/seed.ts` before and after the test run so it is pristine for the next session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Workout Delete feature is fully working (backend + frontend + integration). Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_workout_delete.py (6 tests) covers all activity endpoints. iteration_7 covered everything else - no known regressions.
